text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I went and watched a free race on my day 
off! Running's great, but watching is 
awesome too~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It feels like free-range racers have their 
own kind of pride—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Watching that totally made me want to run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, let me run with everything I've 
got today! Countin' on ya!
